children.description:
Axylophilus yuccae is a beetle in the genus Axylophilus found in Mexico and North America (near Texas), using yucca and palm hosts.
It is characterized by having a blistered abdomen, with many downward facing hairs. It is dull yellow in coloration, with pale brown markings. It's eyes are quite large, and the antenna are inflated at the last two segments.
